scope: Static repository reading and metadata/LFS pointer inspection only; evidence outputs only. No project generation, source/config/doc edit, downloads, registration, builds, tests or Git.

recommendation.entry: Source-engine root configure with explicit absolute LY_PROJECTS fixture path; no project-centric script-only/prebuilt mode
recommendation.reason: No custom project Gem/C++/ECS dependency or Multiplayer; existing engine Editor, AP and project GameLauncher plus existing WhiteBox CSG
recommendation.native_alternative: MinimalProject adds generated project Module/SystemComponent/Gem with Atom_AtomBridge.Static, no requirement demonstrated for this fixture; do not create it by default.
recommendation.platform_limit: Conservative gem.json closure includes platform variants Metal/DX12/Vulkan/Null; actual Windows CMake/PAL target closure still requires configure.

project_files_to_adapt: project.json: replace Name/Version/ProjectId with new explicit project identity, keep script_only:true, engine:o3de; set local descriptive origin/license; remove default restricted placeholder and absent preview reference; replace broad template gem_names with audited seeds; no external_subdirectories Gem
CMakeLists.txt: replace Name and preserve full original Apache-2.0 OR MIT license block; retain original initialization logic. Engine-source LY_PROJECTS path supplies normal C/C++ engine configure.

cmake/EngineFinder.cmake: copy inherited template unchanged with license kept only for optional project-centric use; local CMAKE_MODULE_PATH or user/project.json engine_path can select exact checkout without global registration.

Config/shader_global_build_options.json, ShaderLib/viewsrg.srgi/scenesrg.srgi, Registry/assetprocessor_settings.setreg and assimp_settings.setreg: retain text original local scan/build settings and credits; historical Amazon JSON key is a settings namespace, not an AWS acquisition.

Levels/start/start.prefab: adapt only fixture authoring content to camera/directional light/WhiteBox cube or CSG solid; remove sample shaderball/groundplane, HDRi skybox and IBL asset refs. Keep native component type IDs and existing valid local entity IDs; new project UUID must be fresh.

autoexec.cfg: point loadlevel at actual fixture level; preserve game.cfg. AssetBundling SeedList must be refreshed from actual generated spawnable asset IDs if packaging is later required, not copied with stale source GUID.

Assets/materials/WhiteBoxDefault.material: if parent authorizes texture-free fixture authoring, provide project-local material at the same consumed product path using existing StandardPBR type, no default_grid parent or image references, explicit constant color/useTexture:false. Keep original engine material untouched and rely on audited project scan priority override. This is ordinary authored data, not a new material/renderer system; full shader closure remains pending.

Resources/GameSDK.ico and Splash.bmp: template and common launcher ICO are LFS pointers. Provide valid original/licensed local inputs or separately authorized small original fixture resources; never copy pointer bytes as binaries. Native Launcher.rc.in references both files, so omitting only one is insufficient.

LICENSE.txt/LICENSE_APACHE2.TXT/LICENSE_MIT.TXT: preserve original O3DE distribution/license texts and template notices; newly authored fixture asset license/provenance explicit. No UUID reuse from an unrelated project; no changes to component class UUIDs.

integration.projects: cmake/Projects.cmake records absolute project paths/names, reads gem_names/external_subdirectories, sets LY_DEFAULT_PROJECT_PATH for one project and writes only user build registry/presets
integration.targets: Engine Editor and AssetProcessor/AssetProcessorBatch plus JEEditorFixture.GameLauncher and JEEditorFixture.Assets
integration.assets_target: launcher_generator.cmake executes existing APBatch --zeroAnalysisMode --project-path=<fixture> --platforms=<platform>, with project lock file; it is EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
integration.variants: WhiteBox Clients/Servers/Unified runtime; Tools/Builders load WhiteBox.Editor and existing OpenMesh+Manifold. EditorPythonBindings and QtForPython Tools/Builders only; PhysX5 provides native runtime and editor physics.
integration.generation: Original engine_template.create_project copies templates, performs substitutions, creates UUIDs and registers unless --no-register; --keep-license-text required to preserve template license blocks. EngineFinder inherits through registered local templates. No generator executed; smallest manual local Windows-only subset can avoid global registration and copying absent LFS resources.

dependency_limits.python_tools: CPython3.10.13 + pybind11; QtForPython requires Qt Widgets/Test + pyside6 runtime/Tools. Previously provisioned Qt/PySide archives do not prove Editor imports or linkage.
dependency_limits.physics: 3rdParty::PhysX5 circular static library consumer still required
dependency_limits.shader_assets: Existing ShaderBuilder needs mcpp, DirectXShaderCompilerDxc and SPIRVCross plus existing AZSL compiler pipeline
dependency_limits.image_assets: ImageProcessingAtom retains Qt, astc-encoder, squish-ccr, TIFF, ISPCTexComp and OpenEXR; minimal project does not remove these existing builders
dependency_limits.no_Amazon: No AWS/Multiplayer/GameLift gem in conservative metadata closure. No boto3/botocore/s3transfer installation proposed. Full native dependency/network closure remains governed by existing offline resolver/audits.

asset_findings.both_default_levels: Regular 24KB JSON, but both reference shaderball/groundplane azmodels and goegap HDRi/IBL streaming images; they are not complete independent minimal no-LFS scenes
asset_findings.available: Native prefab JSON, material/materialtype JSON, MainPipeline.pass, shader source/include text, icon SVGs and WhiteBox procedural geometry API
asset_findings.missing: Template preview/GameSDK.ico/Splash.bmp plus platform image resources are LFS pointers; WhiteBox UV TIFs and default_grid three Default TIFs are pointers
asset_findings.whitebox_render: WhiteBoxAtomRenderMesh loads materials/whiteboxdefault.azmaterial and returns without a model when material missing. Setting tint or useTexture off on component alone does not remove this dependency.
asset_findings.pending: Complete Atom pipeline/fonts/default image/shader asset closure not audited or cooked; no AP job or Editor/launcher frame run.

evidence_detail: inputs.json contains full hashes, 40-node gem dependency graph, both template inventories and focal LFS/material hashes.
acceptance: Proposed coherent path only; not source implementation, configure/build, cooked-asset, Editor/AP/launcher, WhiteBox runtime/visual, performance or legal redistribution PASS.
